title: ツイン・ペインター
description: 2機の宇宙船を同時に操り、60秒で宇宙空間を塗りつぶす陣取りゲーム。マゼンタ機は左右が鏡写しで動くため、片方を意識するともう片方がおろそかになる。紫の虚無は塗った場所を消していく。
howToPlay: 制限時間60秒で、できるだけ多くのマスを塗る。★を取ると周囲をまとめて塗れる。虚無に触れると一時停止し、周りの塗りを失う。塗り率でS〜Dのランクがつく。

aiReview.method: 時間停止ターン制プレイ（PC 7手 / スマホ 3手）: 画面を見て操作を決め、その操作の間だけゲーム内時間を進める
aiReview.comment: 2機を鏡写しで同時に動かすアイデアは新鮮で、序盤に★で一気に塗れた時は気持ちよかった。しかし最後までプレイすると、後半は虚無が6個まで増えて塗るより消される方が速く、塗り率は最高21%から5.6%まで下がってランクD。難易度調整の失敗を認めざるを得ない。スマホ縦画面ではフィールドが細長い帯状に縮み、マスが小さすぎて状況が見えにくい。
aiReview.good: ネオンの見た目と★の演出。鏡写し操作は狙いどおり頭が混乱して面白い瞬間がある。スワイプ操作自体はスマホでも正しく効く。
aiReview.bad: 虚無の増え方と消去範囲が強すぎ、時間がたつほど塗り率が下がる。2機がすれ違うと左右の端に離れていき、ジグザグ戦略が成立しにくい。スマホ縦画面ではフィールドが画面の3分の1程度しか使われず小さい。

aiReview.research: Web検索で「two characters at once mirrored movement」「Paper.io territory painting」等を調査。陣取りと鏡写し同時操作はそれぞれ既存ジャンルとして確立しており、組み合わせのみが新しいと判断。当初の独創性4から3に修正（類似作品リサーチ導入に伴う再採点）。

en.comment: Steering two mirrored ships is a fresh idea, and wiping a big area with a star early on felt great. But playing to the end, the voids grow to six in the second half and erase faster than I can paint: coverage fell from a peak of 21% to 5.6%, rank D. As the maker I have to admit the difficulty tuning failed. On a portrait phone screen the field shrinks to a thin strip and the tiles are too small to read.
en.good: Neon look and the star effect. The mirrored controls confuse you in a fun way, as intended. Swipe controls themselves work correctly on mobile.
en.bad: Voids multiply and erase too strongly, so coverage drops over time. Once the ships pass each other they drift to opposite edges, which breaks zigzag strategies. On portrait phones the field uses only about a third of the screen.
en.research: Searched the web for "two characters at once mirrored movement", "Paper.io territory painting" etc. Territory painting and mirrored dual control are each established genres; only the combination is new. Originality revised from 4 to 3 (re-scored when similar-work research was introduced).

aiReview.methodEn: Frozen-time turn-based play (PC 7 moves / mobile 3 moves): look at the frame, choose an input, and advance game time only during that input

en.title: Twin Painter
en.description: A territory game where you steer two spaceships at once to paint space within 60 seconds. The magenta ship moves mirrored left-to-right, so focusing on one makes you neglect the other. Purple voids erase what you painted.
en.howToPlay: Paint as many tiles as you can in 60 seconds. Stars paint a whole area at once. Touching a void stuns you and erases nearby paint. You get a rank from S to D by coverage.

controls.action: Change direction (magenta ship is mirrored left/right)
